p: For a trend question, compare the first, middle and last values. A rise then a fall is a peak shape. Pharmacokinetics: Cmax is the peak concentration and Tmax is the time it occurs.

bp1034_0.trap: Option A suggests a rapid rise at 1 hour, which neither the table nor the passage supports.
bp1034_0.eli: Imagine a bathtub: the drug pours in (rising), then drains out (falling). The highest water level is the peak.
mem: Cmax = highest concentration; Tmax = time of that peak.
Trend = look at start, middle and end values.
Oral drugs usually take hours to peak.

bp1034_0.mn: C-max = Crest, T-max = Time of the crest.
